entries.text: Ridgeline Audio registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Ridgeline Studio Monitor: a two-way nearfield speaker with a woven cone. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Superseded product terms. Billing model: this speaker was previously sold through a recurring monthly subscription with automatic renewal.

Current product terms. Intended use: home studio monitoring in a treated room. Billing model: a one-time purchase with no subscription and no automatic renewal. This record replaces the earlier terms record.
